close_reason: fixed: KNOWN_FILTER_KEYS and SERVER_SET have comments documenting sync requirement
description: mailbox.rs line 189 defines KNOWN_FILTER_KEYS as a hardcoded &[&str] that must match the fields of MailboxFilterCondition. No compile-time enforcement. If a new filter field is added to the struct (e.g. 'minSize'), it must also be added to KNOWN_FILTER_KEYS or valid client filter requests return unsupportedFilter silently. SERVER_SET in the same file (line 605) has the same pattern for server-set field protection on update. Maintenance consequence: struct additions are silently protocol-breaking without a compiler error.
title: KNOWN_FILTER_KEYS must be manually synced with MailboxFilterCondition
